details: No static or traced evidence of exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent-relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or self-propagation was observed in the four scanned files of this package version. The package name resembles a corporate/PayPal-adjacent naming pattern, but name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat and no code-level installer harm is present in the artifacts analyzed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
